description: Read-only. The link sources Katto can clip from (YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Vimeo, Zoom, Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, LinkedIn, Facebook, Rumble, Dailymotion, Medal.tv, or a direct https link to a video file), each with an example URL. Use it to confirm a URL is supported before calling katto_create_clip_job; for a local file use katto_upload_video instead.
name: katto_list_sources
